site.name: ONUR TEMEL
site.pageTitle: ONUR TEMEL — Videographer & Moving Image Archive
site.description: Portfolio of videographer Onur Temel. Observational documentary, performance capture, artist film documentation, and exhibition archives.

bio.short: Videographer and camera operator specializing in contemporary art documentation, long-form performance recording, and observational documentary.
bio.long: Onur Temel works across contemporary art institutions, exhibition catalogues, and independent film productions. His practice focuses on quiet spatial observation, natural acoustic dynamics, and precise visual documentation of multi-disciplinary performances.
